rows.tip: A new radial starts on this character only.
rows.label: Available To
rows.desc: Which of your characters get this radial. Each character gets every radial available to it when it logs in.

rows.tip: Alt, Ctrl and Shift combinations work. Right-click to clear it. Two radials can share a key: on a character that gets both, the narrower one wins (This character, then class, then faction).
rows.label: Key
rows.desc: Opens this radial on every character that gets it.

rows.tip: A key set this way wins over any other radial on the same key.
rows.label: Only This Character
rows.desc: Gives this character its own key for this radial. Your other characters keep the shared key.

rows.tip: Right-click to clear it. A stick with no radial on it keeps its own job (L3 Auto Run, R3 ping).
rows.label: Controller Stick
rows.desc: Gamepad mode: press L3 or R3, alone or with LT, RT or both held. That press opens this radial.

rows.tip: On this character only. Right-click to take it off the bar.
rows.label: Controller Bar
rows.desc: Gamepad mode: press a slot of your controller bar (A, B, X, Y or the D-pad, alone or with LT, RT or both held). The radial goes on that slot.

rows.tip: A clash means two radials with the same reach share a key. The first in the list wins.
rows.label: On This Character
rows.desc: Every key that opens a radial on the character you're playing.

rows.tip: Macro conditionals work.
rows.label: Create Macro
rows.desc:
Puts a macro on your cursor that opens this radial from an action bar or another radial:
* Press the macro: opens it
* Click: uses the button you point at
* Press it again, right-click or Escape: closes it

rows.tip: Radial macros open there too. The controller always opens it in the middle.
rows.label: Menu Position
rows.desc:
Where the radial opens.
* Mouse cursor: where your mouse is
* Screen centre: the middle of the screen

rows.tip: Toggle: middle-click a nested radial to open it in place. The mouse wheel still steps through it.
rows.label: Activation
rows.desc:
How a keybind opens the radial.
* Hold: hold the key, point, release to use
* Toggle: press to open, then left-click to use; press again or right-click to close (right-click goes back from a nested radial)

rows.label: Radial Scale
rows.desc: The size of the whole radial, buttons and ring.

rows.label: Show Button Names
rows.desc: The button you point at shows its action's name.

rows.tip: Off while ConsolePort or another controller addon is loaded: it binds the controller itself.
rows.label: Controller Support
rows.desc: Radials open from a controller in Gamepad mode. Set each radial's controller buttons in the Radials tab.

rows.tip: Off: aim, then press R3.
rows.label: Release the Stick to Use
rows.desc: Push the right stick at a button and let go to use it.

rows.label: Press Again to Repeat
rows.desc: The button you used last is lit when the radial opens. Press the radial's controller button again to use it.

rows.label: Controller Buttons
rows.desc: What each button does while a radial is open. The camera holds still while you aim.

rows.label: Sync Blizz UI
rows.desc:
Copies one character's Blizzard settings to all others:
* Interface options
* Edit Mode layout
* Chat and bag settings

rows.label: No source yet.
rows.desc: Every other character copies its settings from this one.

rows.tip: Loot rolls and toasts move in Edit Mode.
rows.label: Move Any Window
rows.desc:
Move and resize any Blizzard window:
* Drag the header: move
* Ctrl + mouse wheel: resize (a plain wheel still zooms the camera)
* Shift + right-click: reset the position
* Ctrl + right-click: reset the size

rows.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls). Default keeps Blizzard's 10.
rows.label: Columns
rows.desc: How many slots each row of the combined backpack holds.

rows.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls).
rows.label: Gaps Between Bags
rows.desc: Each bag starts on a new row of the combined backpack, with a gap above it.

rows.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls).
rows.label: Integrated Bag Buttons
rows.desc:
Your bag slots down the side of the combined backpack:
* Drag bags in and out
* Hover one to light its items

rows.tip: Empty slots stay bronze.
rows.label: Rarity Colours
rows.desc: Every item is framed in its quality colour: grey, white, green, blue, purple or orange.

rows.tip: Every slot has FlareUI's thin bronze frame while this is off.
rows.label: Thicker Borders
rows.desc: Your bag slots get FlareUI's thick frame instead of the thin one.

rows.label: Junk Coin
rows.desc: Grey items worth money show a coin all the time, not only at a vendor.

rows.tip: A rough guide from the item's stats: your main stat counts most, then Stamina, then other ratings. It can't judge special effects.
rows.label: Upgrade Arrow
rows.desc: Gear you can wear that beats what you have on shows a green arrow in the corner.

rows.label: Faster Auto Loot
rows.desc: Loots everything at once, without the loot window.

rows.label: Skip Loot Confirmations
rows.desc:
No "will bind to you" question when you:
* Loot an item
* Roll Need or Greed

rows.label: Better Camera
rows.desc: The camera zooms out further, and faster.

rows.tip: Hold Shift to read one first. Grey and repeatable quests wait for you.
rows.label: Auto Accept Quests
rows.desc: Accepts the quests an NPC offers when you talk to them.

rows.tip: Hold Shift to stop it. A choice of rewards, a gold cost or a repeatable quest waits for you.
rows.label: Auto Turn-In Quests
rows.desc: Turns in your finished quests when you talk to the NPC.

rows.label: Auto Type "delete"
rows.desc: Fills in DELETE when you destroy a valuable item.

rows.label: Train All Skills
rows.desc: A Train All button at class and profession trainers.

rows.tip: /way 45 60, or /way Elwynn Forest 45 60.
rows.label: Map Pins on "/way"
rows.desc: Type /way and coordinates to pin a spot on the map.

rows.tip: A character shows up once you've logged in on it.

rows.desc:
A button beside Send Mail's "To:" lists:
* The last character you mailed
* Your other characters here

rows.tip: Heard even with sound effects off.
rows.label: Alert Sounds
rows.desc:
Flashes the taskbar and plays a sound for:
* Ready checks
* Summons and resurrections
* Group invites
* Dungeon queues

rows.label: Pet Food Marker
rows.desc: A paw marks the food in your bags your hunter pet eats.

rows.tip: Not in combat, and not in the Gamepad UI.
rows.label: Double-Click to Fish
rows.desc: With a fishing pole in hand, right-click the world twice quickly to cast Fishing.

rows.tip: Your volumes come back when you move, fight or stop fishing for a while.
rows.label: Fishing Sounds
rows.desc: While you fish, the music and ambience go down and sound effects go up, so you hear the bobber splash.

rows.tip: Turning it off restores your own setting.
rows.label: Fade Map While Moving
rows.desc: The world map turns see-through while you walk or ride, so you can see where you're going.

rows.tip: Hold Shift to talk to them as usual.
rows.label: Open Flight Map at Once
rows.desc: Talking to a flight master opens the flight map straight away, unless they have a quest for you.

rows.tip: Off: no question. /fui pad still switches. Never asks while ConsolePort or another controller addon is loaded.

rows.tip: Only while you play with the controller.

rows.desc: Your controller rumbles for a ready check, a queue invite, a summon, a resurrection or a group invite.

rows.tip: Only while you play with the controller.

rows.label: Combo Points

rows.label: Quest Objectives

rows.label: Auto Repair

rows.label: Durability Warning
rows.desc: Warns you when your gear drops below 50% durability.

rows.label: Grey Out Known Items
rows.desc: Recipes and items you already know are greyed out at vendors.

rows.tip: It buys as many as your gold, bag space and the vendor's stock allow, one stack at a time.
rows.label: Buy More Than One Stack

rows.tip: Bags full, not enough money and quest log full still show.

* New: FlareUI's defaults

* Duplicate: a copy of the profile in use

qt.spacing.desc: The tracker's width, how tall it grows before it scrolls, and the gap between quests.
qt.spacing.label: Quest Spacing

about.layout.label: Edit Mode Layout
about.layout.text:
Want your screen set up like ours? Import the FlareUI layout into Edit Mode:

`1.` Click `Copy Layout Code` and press `Ctrl+C`.
`2.` Press `Esc` and choose `Edit Mode`.
`3.` Open the `Layout` menu and choose `Import`.
`4.` Paste with `Ctrl+V`, name it and click `Import`.

about.links.label: Links
about.links.text: Click a button to copy its link

about.thanks.label: Thank You
about.thanks.text: Hope you enjoy FlareUI! Found a bug or have an idea? Give me a holler through the links below

adv.manage.desc:
* New: FlareUI's defaults
* Rename: a new name for the profile in use
* Duplicate: a copy of the profile in use
* Delete: removes a profile you aren't using
adv.manage.label: Manage Profiles
adv.manage.tip: New and Duplicate switch to the new profile and reload. Rename needs no reload.

adv.profiles.label: Active Profile
adv.profiles.tip: Each character keeps its own choice. Switching profiles reloads the interface.

adv.reset.label: Reset FlareUI
adv.reset.desc: Puts every FlareUI setting back to default.

ch.channels.label: Chat Channels
ch.channels.desc: The channels and voice chat button.

adv.share.desc:
* Export: the profile in use as a text string, to copy and share
* Import: paste a string, then pick which parts to take, as a new profile or into the one in use
adv.share.label: Share Profile
adv.share.tip: Import shows the FlareUI version and UI scale the string was made with, and any fonts or textures it uses that you don't have. It reloads after. Blizzard's Edit Mode layouts are shared from Edit Mode itself.

au.*.perRow.desc: The size of the icons, and how many fit in a row.
au.*.perRow.label: Icons per Row

ch.copyButton.label: Copy Chat Button
ch.copyButton.desc: A small note icon in the top right corner of each chat window. Click it to see that window's lines in a box you can copy from.

au.arrive.label: Arrival Animation
au.arrive.desc: New icons fade in while dropping into place.
au.arrive.tip: Plays where an icon is added, so with a sort that moves icons around it can land on the last slot.

ch.copyLinks.label: Copy Chat Links
ch.copyLinks.desc: Click a web link in chat to copy it.

ch.editBox.label: Edit Box Position
ch.editBox.tip: Below and Above keep the latest messages in view.

au.font.count.desc: The stack count on each icon.
au.font.count.label: Aura Stacks

au.font.timer.desc: The time left on each icon.
au.font.timer.label: Aura Timers

au.mineFirst.label: Your Auras First
au.mineFirst.desc: Your own auras lead the row.
au.mineFirst.tip: Only with Time left or Name.

ch.editBoxOpacity.label: Edit Box Opacity
ch.editBoxOpacity.desc: How dark the edit box's background is.

ch.fade.label: Fade Speed
ch.fade.desc:
How fast the chat appears and disappears.
* Fast: 0.2 seconds
* Slow: 0.4 seconds

au.reverse.label: Reverse Order
au.reverse.tip: Newest, longest left or Z first.

au.shape.label: Aura Icon Shape
au.shape.desc: The shape of your buff and debuff icons.

ch.fadeDelay.desc: How long the chat stays before it fades.
ch.fadeDelay.label: Fade Delay
ch.fadeDelay.tip: Needs a Visibility other than Always.

tt.showFrames.desc: When tooltips appear for what you point at.
tt.showFrames.label: On Unit Frames
tt.showFrames.tip: Hold Shift to see a hidden tooltip.

tt.showGuild.label: Show Guild Name
tt.showGuild.desc: The guild line on players' tooltips.

au.skinCDM.desc: Blizzard's Cooldown Manager in FlareUI's look: the Tracked Bars like FlareUI's cast bars, the Tracked Buffs icons like these buffs.
au.skinCDM.label: Skin Cooldown Manager
au.skinCDM.tip: Its size, layout and what it tracks stay in Blizzard's Cooldown Manager and its Edit Mode dialog.

tt.showGuildRank.label: Show Guild Ranks
tt.showGuildRank.desc: Adds the player's rank after their guild's name.

au.sort.desc: How your buffs and debuffs line up.
au.sort.label: Sort By
au.sort.tip: Time left puts the auras about to end first. Permanent ones go last.

tt.showWorld.desc: When tooltips appear for what you point at.
tt.showWorld.label: In the World
tt.showWorld.tip: Hold Shift to see a hidden tooltip.

ch.formatNPC.label: Better NPC Names
ch.formatNPC.desc: NPC speech starts with an orange [Name] instead of "Name says:".
ch.formatNPC.tip: Off in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds: Blizzard locks chat there.

uf.*.auraReverse.desc: How this frame's auras line up. Default sorting is Blizzard's: yours first, then the important ones.
uf.*.auraReverse.label: Reverse Order

au.swipe.label: Aura Swipe
au.swipe.desc: How the time remaining for auras is shown.

uf.*.buffSize.label: Buff Size
uf.*.buffSize.desc: The size of buff icons. Each row holds as many as fit.

ch.formatPlayer.label: Better Player Names
ch.formatPlayer.desc: Player names in their class colour, without the realm.
ch.formatPlayer.tip: Off in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds: Blizzard locks chat there.

ch.history.label: Save History
ch.history.desc: Keeps your conversations through reloads and relogs: what players say, and your whispers.
ch.history.tip: Loot, money and system lines are left out. Old lines come back with the time they were said.

ch.hoverTooltips.label: Link Tooltips on Mouseover
ch.hoverTooltips.desc: Point at an item, spell or quest link in chat to see its tooltip.

qt.width.desc: The tracker's width, how tall it grows before it scrolls, and the gap between quests.
qt.width.label: Width

qt.wrap.label: Wrap Long Text
qt.wrap.desc: Long lines continue on the next line instead of being cut.

ch.border.desc: The border around the chat and its edit box.
ch.border.label: Border

uf.*.comboPoints.desc: The combo point bar along the top of the health bar (Addon Style). In FlareUI Style: Classic, Modern or Off.
uf.*.comboPoints.label: Combo Points

qt.zoneHeaders.label: Zone Headings
qt.zoneHeaders.desc: Quests grouped under their zone's name.
qt.zoneHeaders.tip: Shift-click a heading to fold all its quests.

uf.*.debuffSize.label: Debuff Size
uf.*.debuffSize.desc: The size of debuff icons. Each row holds as many as fit.

ch.menu.label: Chat Menu
ch.menu.desc: The menu with emotes, languages and chat options.

rb.*.fsr.label: Five-Second Rule
rb.*.fsr.desc: After you spend mana, a spark crosses the bar for five seconds.
rb.*.fsr.tip: Spirit regeneration resumes when the spark ends.

uf.*.debuffs.label: Debuffs
uf.*.debuffs.tip: On the cast bar's side, they sit beyond it.
uf.*.debuffs.desc: Where auras sit around the frame.

uf.*.healthText.label: Health Text
uf.*.healthText.desc: The numbers on the health bar.

ch.noBubbles.label: Hide Bubbles in Instances
ch.noBubbles.desc: No chat bubbles in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds.

uf.*.level.desc: The unit's level next to its name.
uf.*.level.label: Show Level

rb.combo.label: Combo Points
rb.combo.desc: Your combo points as a segmented bar.

uf.*.mirror.desc: Flips the frame to face the player frame. In FlareUI and Forever Style, only the bars' direction.
uf.*.mirror.label: Mirror

rb.font.text.desc: Numbers and labels on the resource bars.
rb.font.text.label: Bar Text

rb.health.label: Health
rb.health.desc: Your health as its own bar.

uf.*.portrait.label: Portrait
uf.*.portrait.desc: What shows in the portrait circle.

rb.health.text.label: Health Text
rb.health.text.desc: The numbers on the health bar.

ch.timestamps.label: Better Timestamps
ch.timestamps.desc: A short time in blue before each message, like <12:30>.
ch.timestamps.tip: Off in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds: Blizzard locks chat there.

ch.visibility.desc:
When the chat stays on screen.
* Always: never fades
* Chat Interactions: new messages and typing
* Chat Interactions + In Combat: also during fights
ch.visibility.label: Visibility
ch.visibility.tip: Pointing at the chat always shows it.

mm.zoom.label: Auto Zoom Out
mm.zoom.desc: Zooms the minimap back out a while after you zoom in.

uf.*.powerText.label: Power Text
uf.*.powerText.desc: The number on the power bar.

qol.alerts.label: Alert Sounds
qol.alerts.desc:
Flashes the taskbar and plays a sound for:
* Ready checks
* Summons and resurrections
* Group invites
* Dungeon queues
qol.alerts.tip: Heard even with sound effects off.

ch.volume.label: Volume
ch.volume.desc:
A button for the game's master volume:
* Click: mute or unmute
* Mouse wheel: louder or quieter

rb.swingMain.label: Main-Hand Swing
rb.swingMain.desc: A timer for each weapon's next swing.

qol.autoAcceptQuests.label: Auto Accept Quests
qol.autoAcceptQuests.desc: Accepts the quests an NPC offers when you talk to them.
qol.autoAcceptQuests.tip: Hold Shift to read one first. Grey and repeatable quests wait for you.

dm.chatTab.label: Meter Tab in the Chat
dm.chatTab.desc: A Meter tab beside your chat tabs shows the meter inside the chat window.
dm.chatTab.tip: Click a chat tab to get the chat back, in combat too.

qol.autoTurnInQuests.label: Auto Turn-In Quests
qol.autoTurnInQuests.desc: Turns in your finished quests when you talk to the NPC.
qol.autoTurnInQuests.tip: Hold Shift to stop it. A choice of rewards, a gold cost or a repeatable quest waits for you.

rm.activation.desc:
How a keybind opens the radial.
* Hold: hold the key, point, release to use
* Toggle: press to open, then left-click to use; press again or right-click to close (right-click goes back from a nested radial)
rm.activation.label: Activation
rm.activation.tip: Toggle: middle-click a nested radial to open it in place. The mouse wheel still steps through it.

dm.chatTabIgnoreFade.label: Ignore Chat Fade
dm.chatTabIgnoreFade.desc: The chat window stays up while the Meter tab is open.

qol.bagButtons.label: Integrated Bag Buttons
qol.bagButtons.desc:
Your bag slots down the side of the combined backpack:
* Drag bags in and out
* Hover one to light its items
qol.bagButtons.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls).

dm.chatTabOpen.desc:
When the Meter tab opens on its own.
* When Clicked: only when you click it
* In Combat: during fights, back to the chat after
* In a Group: while you're in a group
* At Login: it starts open
dm.chatTabOpen.label: Open the Meter Tab
dm.chatTabOpen.tip: A click on a tab always wins until the next change.

qol.bagColumns.label: Columns
qol.bagColumns.desc: How many slots each row of the combined backpack holds.
qol.bagColumns.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls). Default keeps Blizzard's 10.

rm.key.label: Key
rm.key.desc: Opens this radial on every character that gets it.
rm.key.tip: Alt, Ctrl and Shift combinations work. Right-click to clear it. Two radials can share a key: on a character that gets both, the narrower one wins (This character, then class, then faction).

dm.combatTimer.label: Combat Timer
dm.combatTimer.desc: The fight's running time in the meter's title.

qol.bagGaps.label: Gaps Between Bags
qol.bagGaps.desc: Each bag starts on a new row of the combined backpack, with a gap above it.
qol.bagGaps.tip: Needs Combined Bags on in Blizzard's options (Controls).

rm.macroCreate.desc:
Puts a macro on your cursor that opens this radial from an action bar or another radial:
* Press the macro: opens it
* Click: uses the button you point at
* Press it again, right-click or Escape: closes it
rm.macroCreate.label: Create Macro
rm.macroCreate.errorInCombat: You can't create macros in combat.
rm.macroCreate.errorMacrosFull: Your macro list is full. Delete one and try again.
rm.macroCreate.done: Macro "{name}" created and on your cursor. Drop it on a bar.

qol.bagJunkIcon.label: Junk Coin
qol.bagJunkIcon.desc: Grey items worth money show a coin all the time, not only at a vendor.

qol.bagRarityBorders.label: Rarity Colours
qol.bagRarityBorders.desc: Every item is framed in its quality colour: grey, white, green, blue, purple or orange.

dm.fadeSpeed.label: Fade Speed
dm.fadeSpeed.desc:
How fast the meter appears and disappears.
* Fast: 0.2 seconds
* Slow: 0.4 seconds

dm.font.bars.desc: Names and numbers on the bars.
dm.font.bars.label: Bars

qol.bagThickBorders.label: Thicker Borders
qol.bagThickBorders.desc: Your bag slots get FlareUI's thick frame instead of the thin one.
qol.bagThickBorders.tip: Every slot has FlareUI's thin bronze frame while this is off.

dm.font.header.desc: The title row: Damage Meter or Threat, the session and its timer.
dm.font.header.label: Header

rm.names.label: Show Button Names
rm.names.desc: The button you point at shows its action's name.

qol.bagUpgradeArrow.label: Upgrade Arrow
qol.bagUpgradeArrow.desc: Gear you can wear that beats what you have on shows a green arrow in the corner.
qol.bagUpgradeArrow.tip: A rough guide from the item's stats: your main stat counts most, then Stamina, then other ratings. It can't judge special effects.

dm.matchChat.label: Match Chat Size
dm.matchChat.desc: The meter takes the chat's width and height.
dm.matchChat.tip: Off: its Edit Mode size comes back.

rm.new.desc: Creates an empty radial. Choose who gets it as you name it.
rm.new.label: New Radial

qol.bulkBuy.label: Buy More Than One Stack
qol.bulkBuy.desc: Shift+click an item at a vendor to buy several stacks at once, such as arrows, reagents or water.
qol.bulkBuy.tip: It buys as many as your gold, bag space and the vendor's stock allow, one stack at a time.

dm.minAlpha.desc: How far the meter fades out. At 0% it disappears.
dm.minAlpha.label: Faded Opacity
dm.minAlpha.tip: With the Meter tab in the chat, the meter fades with the chat.

rm.overview.label: On This Character
rm.overview.desc: Every key that opens a radial on the character you're playing.
rm.overview.tip: A clash means two radials with the same reach share a key. The first in the list wins.

dm.mouseover.label: Show on Mouseover
dm.mouseover.desc: Point at the meter's place to show it.

qol.camera.label: Better Camera
qol.camera.desc: The camera zooms out further, and faster.

rm.ownKey.label: Only This Character
rm.ownKey.desc: Gives this character its own key for this radial. Your other characters keep the shared key.
rm.ownKey.tip: A key set this way wins over any other radial on the same key.

dm.opacity.label: Frame Opacity
dm.opacity.desc: How dark the meter's background is.

qol.delete.label: Auto Type "delete"
qol.delete.desc: Fills in DELETE when you destroy a valuable item.

dm.pullFlash.label: Pull Warning
dm.pullFlash.desc: Your bar on the Threat tab flashes as you near the point where you pull the enemy.

rm.pad.label: Controller Support
rm.pad.desc: Radials open from a controller in Gamepad mode. Set each radial's controller buttons in the Radials tab.
rm.pad.tip: Off while ConsolePort or another controller addon is loaded: it binds the controller itself.

qol.durability.label: Durability Warning
qol.durability.desc: Warns you when your gear drops below 50% durability.
qol.durability.tip: Thrown weapons don't count: they lose durability with every throw.

dm.pullLine.label: Pull Aggro Line
dm.pullLine.desc: A red line on the Threat tab's bars, where you would pull the enemy off the tank.
dm.pullLine.tip: 110% of the tank's threat in melee, 130% at range. Not shown while you are the tank.

rm.padBar.label: Controller Bar
rm.padBar.tip: On this character only. Right-click to take it off the bar.
rm.padBar.desc: Gamepad mode: press a slot of your controller bar (A, B, X, Y or the D-pad, alone or with LT, RT or both held). The radial goes on that slot.

qol.fastLoot.label: Faster Auto Loot
qol.fastLoot.desc: Loots everything at once, without the loot window.

dm.readyCheck.label: Ready Check Button
dm.readyCheck.desc: Starts a ready check from the meter's header.
dm.readyCheck.tip: Shows while you lead or assist a group.

qol.fishCast.label: Double-Click to Fish
qol.fishCast.desc: With a fishing pole in hand, right-click the world twice quickly to cast Fishing.
qol.fishCast.tip: Not in combat, and not in the Gamepad UI.

rm.padLegend.label: Controller Buttons
rm.padLegend.desc: What each button does while a radial is open. The camera holds still while you aim.

dm.resetOnInstance.label: Reset on Entering a Dungeon
dm.resetOnInstance.desc: Clears the meter when you enter a new dungeon or raid.
dm.resetOnInstance.tip: Coming back into the same one (after a ghost run, say) keeps it, unless you were away more than ten minutes.

rm.padRelease.label: Release the Stick to Use
rm.padRelease.desc: Push the right stick at a button and let go to use it.

dm.tankLead.label: Tank's Lead
dm.tankLead.desc: The tank's row on the Threat tab shows how far it is ahead of second place, like "+25%".

rm.padRepeat.label: Press Again to Repeat
rm.padRepeat.desc: The button you used last is lit when the radial opens. Press the radial's controller button again to use it.

rm.padStick.label: Controller Stick
rm.padStick.desc: Gamepad mode: press L3 or R3, alone or with LT, RT or both held. That press opens this radial.
rm.padStick.tip: Right-click to clear it. A stick with no radial on it keeps its own job (L3 Auto Run, R3 ping).

qol.hideErrors.desc: Hides the red error text, like "Not enough rage".
qol.hideErrors.label: Error Messages
qol.hideErrors.tip: Bags full, not enough money and quest log full still show.

rm.position.desc:
Where the radial opens.
* Mouse cursor: where your mouse is
* Screen centre: the middle of the screen
rm.position.label: Menu Position
rm.position.tip: Radial macros open there too. The controller always opens it in the middle.

qol.hideFrameNumbers.label: Frame Numbers
qol.hideFrameNumbers.desc:
Hides on Blizzard's frames:
* Damage numbers on your portrait
* Health and power numbers

dm.visibility.desc:
When the meter shows.
* In Combat: during fights
* In a Group: while you're in a group
* Hidden: never on its own
dm.visibility.label: Visibility
dm.visibility.tip: Show on Mouseover works with every choice. With the Meter tab on, the tab decides.

rm.scale.label: Radial Scale
rm.scale.desc: The size of the whole radial, buttons and ring.

rm.scope.label: Available To
rm.scope.desc: Which of your characters get this radial. Each character gets every radial available to it when it logs in.
rm.scope.tip: A new radial starts on this character only.

font.flags.label: Outline
font.flags.desc: A dark outline around the letters.

qol.mailBook.label: Mail Address Book
qol.mailBook.desc:
A button beside Send Mail's "To:" lists:
* The last character you mailed
* Your other characters here
qol.mailBook.tip: A character shows up once you've logged in on it.

tt.anchor.label: Anchor
tt.anchor.desc:
Where tooltips appear.
* Default: Blizzard's corner
* Cursor: by your mouse

font.shadow.label: Shadow
font.shadow.desc:
A drop shadow under the letters.
* Soft: 1 pixel away
* Strong: 2 pixels away

qol.mapFade.label: Fade Map While Moving
qol.mapFade.desc: The world map turns see-through while you walk or ride, so you can see where you're going.
qol.mapFade.tip: Turning it off restores your own setting.

tt.borders.label: Coloured Borders
tt.borders.desc:
Tooltip borders in the colour of:
* A player's class
* A creature's reaction
* An item's quality

ab.bar.group.label: Fade Group
ab.bar.group.tip: One group for your bottom bars, another for your side bars.
ab.bar.group.desc:
Bars in the same fade group:
* Fade together
* Share their Visibility, Fade Speed and Faded Opacity

tt.classNames.label: Class-Coloured Names
tt.classNames.desc: Player names in their class colour.

mm.bag.label: Addon Button Drawer
mm.bag.desc: Every addon's minimap button in one drawer. Click the day/night badge to open it.
mm.bag.tip: Drag and drop buttons to reorder them.

qol.move.label: Move Any Window
qol.move.desc:
Move and resize any Blizzard window:
* Drag the header: move
* Ctrl + mouse wheel: resize (a plain wheel still zooms the camera)
* Shift + right-click: reset the position
* Ctrl + right-click: reset the size
qol.move.tip: Loot rolls and toasts move in Edit Mode.

tt.compareShift.label: Compare With Shift
tt.compareShift.desc: The tooltips of the gear you wear show beside an item only while you hold Shift.
tt.compareShift.tip: Turning it off restores your own setting.

mm.clockStats.desc: Your framerate and latency in the clock's tooltip.
mm.clockStats.label: FPS and Latency on Clock

qol.npCombat.label: Combat Enemy Plates
qol.npCombat.desc: Enemy nameplates show only during fights.
qol.npCombat.tip: Turning it off restores your own setting.

mm.coordsHover.label: Coordinates on Mouseover
mm.coordsHover.desc: Your coordinates under the minimap show only while you point at it.

tt.font.title.desc: The first line: a name or an item.
tt.font.title.label: Title

qol.npCombo.label: Combo Points
qol.npCombo.desc: Combo point gems under your target's nameplate.

tt.healthBar.label: Health Bar
tt.healthBar.desc: The health bar under unit tooltips.

qol.npLevel.label: Hide Level Box
qol.npLevel.desc: Hides the level box beside Blizzard's nameplates.
qol.npLevel.tip: Quest marks move to the health bar's edge.

tt.hideFaction.label: Hide Faction
tt.hideFaction.desc: Removes the Alliance or Horde line from tooltips.

tt.ids.label: Show IDs
tt.ids.tip: Handy for macros and bug reports.

language.useGame.label: Use the Game Language
language.useGame.desc: Match the language selected in World of Warcraft.

ab.buttonArt.label: Show Button Art
ab.buttonArt.desc: Blizzard's framed slot on every button of bars 1 to 8 and the pet bar, even on bars set to hide their art.

qol.npQuest.label: Quest Objectives
qol.npQuest.desc: A quest mark on enemies you need for a quest.

ab.cleanKeybinds.label: Clean Keybind Text
ab.cleanKeybinds.desc: Shorter key labels on your buttons: SM4 for Shift + Mouse Button 4, SP for Spacebar, WU for Mouse Wheel Up.

qol.petFood.label: Pet Food Marker
qol.petFood.desc: A paw marks the food in your bags your hunter pet eats.

uf.font.castBar.desc: Spell names and times on cast bars.
uf.font.castBar.label: Cast Bar

ab.dimOnCooldown.label: Dim on Cooldown
ab.dimOnCooldown.desc: Buttons turn grey while their spell or item is on cooldown.
ab.dimOnCooldown.tip: The global cooldown after each cast doesn't count.

uf.castbar.desc: Your cast bar in FlareUI's style, placed on its own. Off brings back Blizzard's cast bar.
uf.castbar.label: Player Cast Bar
uf.castbar.tip: For a cast bar on the player frame itself, turn on Cast Bar in its Edit Mode options.

uf.boss.label: Boss Frames
uf.boss.desc: The bosses of an encounter, mirrored like the target frame.

qol.rumbleAlerts.label: Rumble on Alerts
qol.rumbleAlerts.desc: Your controller rumbles for a ready check, a queue invite, a summon, a resurrection or a group invite.
qol.rumbleAlerts.tip: Only while you play with the controller.

ab.fcmBar1.label: Action Bar 1
ab.fcmBar1.desc:
This bar becomes part of a cooldown display:
* Can't be clicked
* Shows only by its Visibility
ab.fcmBar1.tip: No bar picked: Fake CM is off.

tt.shortItemStats.label: Simplified Item Stats
tt.shortItemStats.desc: Item tooltips say "+12 Spell Power" instead of "Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 12." Set bonuses too.

uf.auraTimerColor.label: Timer Colour
uf.auraTimerColor.desc: Aura timers turn yellow under 10 seconds and red under 5.
uf.auraTimerColor.tip: Also on party, raid and boss frames.

qol.rumbleProcs.label: Rumble on Procs
qol.rumbleProcs.desc: A short rumble when a spell lights up on your action bars.
qol.rumbleProcs.tip: Only while you play with the controller.

uf.auraTimer.label: Aura Timer
uf.auraTimer.desc: Where the time left shows on unit frame auras.

uf.auraSwipe.desc: How the time remaining for auras on unit frames is shown.
uf.auraSwipe.label: Aura Swipe
uf.auraSwipe.tip: Also on party, raid and boss frames.

qol.sellJunk.label: Auto Sell Junk
qol.sellJunk.desc: Sells your grey items when you open a vendor.

tt.showBars.desc: When tooltips appear for what you point at.
tt.showBars.label: On Action/Data Bars
tt.showBars.tip: Hold Shift to see a hidden tooltip.

uf.auraShape.label: Aura Icon Shape
uf.auraShape.desc: The shape of buff and debuff icons on unit frames.

qol.skipLoot.label: Skip Loot Confirmations
qol.skipLoot.desc:
No "will bind to you" question when you:
* Loot an item
* Roll Need or Greed

dm.threatValue.desc: What the Threat tab shows beside each name.
dm.threatValue.label: Threat Text

dm.countdown.label: Countdown Button
dm.countdown.desc: Starts a 10-second pull countdown from the meter's header.
dm.countdown.tip: Shows while you're in a group.

qol.source.label: Make This Character the Source
qol.source.desc: Every other character copies its settings from this one.

au.*.size.desc: The size of the icons, and how many fit in a row.
au.*.size.label: Icon Size

ab.bar.show.desc: When this bar appears. Tick as many conditions as you like: any one of them shows it.
ab.bar.show.label: Visibility
ab.bar.show.tip: Always or Mouseover clears the others. Pointing at the bar, or opening your spellbook, always shows it.

ab.xpText.desc: When the XP bar shows its numbers.
ab.xpText.label: XP Text Visibility
ab.xpText.tip: Place and size the XP bar in Edit Mode.

qol.sync.label: Sync Blizz UI
qol.sync.desc:
Copies one character's Blizzard settings to all others:
* Interface options
* Edit Mode layout
* Chat and bag settings

qol.npNames.label: Hide Names
qol.npNames.desc: Hides unit names on Blizzard's nameplates.
qol.npNames.tip: Friendly players shown by name only keep their names.

qol.fishSound.label: Fishing Sounds
qol.fishSound.desc: While you fish, the music and ambience go down and sound effects go up, so you hear the bobber splash.
qol.fishSound.tip: Your volumes come back when you move, fight or stop fishing for a while.

qol.taxiMap.label: Open Flight Map at Once
qol.taxiMap.desc: Talking to a flight master opens the flight map straight away, unless they have a quest for you.
qol.taxiMap.tip: Hold Shift to talk to them as usual.

qol.hideZoneText.label: Zone Text
qol.hideZoneText.desc: Hides the big zone name when you enter a new area.

qol.merchantKnown.label: Grey Out Known Items
qol.merchantKnown.desc: Recipes and items you already know are greyed out at vendors.

qol.npLevelName.desc: Puts the unit's level in front of its name on Blizzard's nameplates, coloured by how hard an enemy is.
qol.npLevelName.label: Level Before Names
qol.npLevelName.tip: Needs Hide Level Box on and Hide Names off.

qol.trainAll.label: Train All Skills
qol.trainAll.desc: A Train All button at class and profession trainers.

qol.repair.label: Auto Repair
qol.repair.desc: Repairs your gear at vendors that can.

qt.hideLevel.label: Hide Quest Level
qt.hideLevel.desc: No level in front of quest names.

mm.style.label: Style
mm.style.desc: FlareUI's square minimap, or Forever's own round one.

mm.microMenu.label: Middle-Click Menu
mm.microMenu.desc: Middle-click the minimap for a list of game panels: character, spellbook, talents, quest log and more.

mm.font.zone.desc: The zone's name along the top of the minimap.
mm.font.zone.label: Zone Name

mm.font.clock.desc: The time at the right end of the bar.
mm.font.clock.label: Clock

qt.tags.label: Quest Tags
qt.tags.desc:
A short tag after the quest name:
* + elite
* g3 group of 3
* d dungeon, r raid
* pvp

ab.autoRanks.label: Update Spell Ranks
ab.autoRanks.desc: A newly learned rank replaces the rank below it on your bars.
ab.autoRanks.tip: Also catches up at login and when turned on, for ranks learned while it was off. Spell buttons on your radial menus cast each character's best rank. Lower ranks you placed on purpose stay.

rb.*.show.label: Visibility
rb.*.show.desc: When the bar appears. Tick as many conditions as you like: any one of them shows it.

qol.gamepadPrompt.label: Gamepad Mode Prompt
qol.gamepadPrompt.desc: Pressing a controller button asks whether to switch to Blizzard's Gamepad UI.
qol.gamepadPrompt.tip: Off: no question. /fui pad still switches. Never asks while ConsolePort or another controller addon is loaded.

rm.copy.desc: Makes a copy with the same buttons and the same reach, without a key. Handy for a Horde or class version.
rm.copy.label: Copy

rb.swingRanged.label: Ranged Swing
rb.swingRanged.desc: A timer for each weapon's next swing.

rb.swingOff.label: Off-Hand Swing
rb.swingOff.desc: A timer for each weapon's next swing.

rb.power.label: Power
rb.power.desc: Your rage, energy, mana or focus.

rb.mana.label: Druid Mana
rb.mana.desc: Your mana while in cat or bear form.
rb.mana.tip: In caster form, Power shows your mana.

ch.social.label: Social
ch.social.desc: The friends and Quick Join button.

ch.shortChannels.label: Short Channel Names
ch.shortChannels.tip: Off in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds: Blizzard locks chat there.

ch.opacity.label: Frame Opacity
ch.opacity.desc: How dark the chat's background is.

ch.minAlpha.label: Faded Opacity
ch.minAlpha.desc: How far the chat fades out. At 0% it disappears.

ch.lineHeight.label: Increase Line Height
ch.lineHeight.desc: A little more space between chat lines.

ch.levels.label: Level Before Names
ch.levels.desc: The sender's level before their name, when known.
ch.levels.tip: Off in dungeons, raids and battlegrounds: Blizzard locks chat there.

au.timerColor.label: Timer Colour
au.timerColor.desc: Timers turn yellow under 10 seconds and red under 5.

uf.*.auraMineFirst.desc: How this frame's auras line up. Default sorting is Blizzard's: yours first, then the important ones.
uf.*.auraMineFirst.label: Your Auras First

uf.*.auraSort.desc: How this frame's auras line up. Default sorting is Blizzard's: yours first, then the important ones.
uf.*.auraSort.label: Sort By

uf.*.buffs.label: Buffs
uf.*.buffs.tip: On the cast bar's side, they sit beyond it.
uf.*.buffs.desc: Where auras sit around the frame.

tt.showThreat.label: Show Threat
tt.showThreat.desc: Your threat on an enemy, as a percentage, on its tooltip.
